name: YarnSpinnerTool/YarnSpinner
description: Yarn Spinner is a friendly, screenplay-like tool for writing branching dialogue in games, used in Night in the Woods, A Short Hike, and Dredge. Supports Unity, Godot, and Rust integrations.
score_rationale: Industry-recognized dialogue framework used in many successful indie games, actively maintained with 2.7k stars and a growing cross-engine ecosystem.
summary: Multi-engine branching dialogue framework used in Night in the Woods, A Short Hike
